assets.imagegen_prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: ultra-wide standalone marketing illustration
Primary request: create a new regeneration of the supplied residential architectural line-art reference. Preserve the exact broad building arrangement, low horizontal baseline, central taller mass, lower wings, balconies, repeated windows, entry steps, planted beds, and mature trees at both sides. Use the input only as a visual reference; do not copy pixels.
Input images: Image 1 is a reference image only for composition, subject, and line-art treatment.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat FairLend electric-lime #8DFF00 from edge to edge, with no gradient, texture, vignette, floor plane, shadow, or lighting variation.
Subject: a wide contemporary multi-unit residential complex rendered as delicate architectural pen-and-ink line art with graphite-gray hatching, near-black details, restrained magenta-violet construction accents, and stippled foliage.
Style/medium: high-detail architectural concept sketch, clean editorial linework, lightly imperfect hand-rendered contours, no filled-color illustration.
Composition/framing: shallow ultra-wide banner matching the supplied 1202:370 composition. Keep the entire complex centered inside the middle horizontal band, occupying roughly 78% of the canvas height at most. Leave generous uninterrupted electric-lime negative space above the tallest roofline and below the baseline, plus clear side margins around the outer trees. Do not zoom in; do not let the buildings or trees touch any edge; preserve the low baseline and long horizontal footprint.
Lighting/mood: flat graphic presentation; quiet, premium, technical, optimistic.
Color palette: exact #8DFF00 electric lime field; charcoal, graphite, soft gray, and restrained magenta-violet only in the drawing.
Materials/textures: fine brick courses, window mullions, architectural hatching, delicate foliage stippling; all texture confined to the subject.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: generate a new standalone raster image; preserve the reference geometry and visual density; keep every building and tree fully inside frame; no people, cars, signage, logos, extra structures, or photographic effects.
Avoid: white or cream background, off-white halo, gradient, shadows, reflections, watermark, text, logo, photorealism, cartoon simplification, cropped rooflines, clipped trees, distorted perspective, neon-colored drawing fills, or background detail.
